sv.title: Alice, 33, dog – hade fillers i hjärtat
sv.summary: 33-åriga Alice Webb skulle göra ett rumplyft. Det kostade henne livet. Nu visar en utredning att hon hade spår av fillers i hjärta och hjärna.

en.title: Alice, 33, died – had fillers in her heart
en.summary: 33-year-old Alice Webb was going to get a tummy tuck. It cost her her life. Now an investigation shows she had traces of fillers in her heart and brain.
